Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate you and Marion carving time. I recorded the session and dropped the slides into Drive so your team can pass them around: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGhIJkL-bridgepath-demo (recording + slides attached).

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the recording and the slides — caught up with Marion this morning. We liked the throughput numbers and the cache behavior you showed. Two quick asks before we lock something down:

1) Could you include a short pricing summary (T-shirt / per-token run-rate + expected savings with batching) so Marion (CFO) can eyeball economics?
2) Marion also asked to join any Q&A — I’ve cc’d her here (marion.zhao@bridgepath.io).

We can do a 10-minute session on Wed 4/28 at 11:00 PT. If you can share a concise one-pager ahead of that, that would be ideal.

Cheers,

Alex / Marion —

Great — appreciate the quick reply. I attached a short pricing one-pager (BridgePath-pricing-onepager-20270427.pdf) that lays out:
- 2 baseline flavors: hosted API (pay-as-you-go) and dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit)
- Example run-rate for a 5M token/month workload + estimated batching savings (15–25% depending on prefix reuse)
- Rough integration touchpoints and typical time-to-first-query (2–4 weeks for sample pipelines)

Wed 4/28 11:00 PT works for our team — I’ve booked a 10-minute slot and added Monica (Solutions Engineer) so we can cover the integration question you had about KV cache reuse.

Proposed quick agenda (10 min):
1) 2-min recap of technical fit (Monica)
2) 4-min pricing & deployment options (Ben)
3) 4-min open Q&A (all)

If that looks good, join here: https://meet.google.com/redwood-bridgepath-0428

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Ben Carter
